title: Objection, appeal and final-outcome records
scope: Link investigation decision to objections, appeals and reviewed final outcomes

acceptance.text: Link investigation decision to objections, appeals and reviewed final outcomes
Overturned findings remain traceable and trigger review signals without rewriting original evidence
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: Overturned findings remain traceable and trigger review signals without rewriting original evidence

evidence.text: Implemented vati_tax.challenges (rules/service/store/api) + Vati Decision Challenge DocType: objection to an approved Vati Decision, appeal linked to the reviewed objection (parent_challenge_id), reviewed outcome (upheld/partially_overturned/overturned/withdrawn) by a supervisor who did not propose/approve the decision, lodge it or review the objection; get_challenge_history returns decision -> objection -> appeal -> final_outcome. Observed 2026-11-05: 22 Frappe-free tests pass (challenges/test_service.py); bench module challenges/test_challenges_bench 6/6 OK on a Frappe v16.54.0 site incl. test_objection_appeal_and_final_outcome_are_linked_and_persisted. ADR-023.

Observed 2026-11-05 on a Frappe site (bench run-tests --module vati_tax.challenges.test_challenges_bench, 6/6 OK): after an overturned review the Vati Decision row (decided fields and modified timestamp) and all earlier audit-ledger entries are unchanged, the chain verifies intact, Jube received no extra call; a review_only decision_overturned signal names the original proposer and is withheld from that viewer. Frappe-free tests also cover decision_changed refusal when the decision differs from the lodged digest and that sync bookkeeping is not treated as a change. scripts/frappe_dev.py verify (clean site, migrate twice, 133 bench + 321 app tests) exit 0. Mutation check: removing proposer/approver exclusion, taxpayer ownership, digest check, overturn signal or approved-only rule each fails the suite.
